problem_plain: Belden wanted to expand beyond selling hardware (cables, switches and network equipment) to offer software that enables customers to manage factory and warehouse networks more intelligently.
capability: AI-powered platform (Belden Horizon) that collects data from machines and network devices on the factory floor and provides real-time insights for remote network management and problem detection.
scale_outcomes: Ambition for 20% of business to come from solutions by 2028
reusable: The approach of adding AI-powered software solutions to hardware products to create new revenue streams and deepen customer relationships through ongoing service engagement.
summary: Veridane helped Belden build Belden Horizon, an AI platform that collects factory floor data and provides real-time network insights for remote management. The solution opens new revenue streams and aims for 20% of Belden's business to come from solutions by 2028.
